definitions.explanation: the plural form of それ, referring to multiple items or concepts that are near the listener or previously mentioned in conversation

examples.japanese: それら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です。
それら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}いましょう→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。

⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、それら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled the survey results, but those data have not yet been made public.

notes:
The plural form of ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ (that). Part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system: ⟦これら→これら：02814_korera⟧ (these, near speaker), それら (those, near listener or previously mentioned), ⟦あれら→あれら：23758_arera⟧ (those, distant from both).

USAGE:
More common in written and formal Japanese than in everyday conversation. In casual speech, Japanese speakers tend to use ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ without the plural marker, since Japanese nouns do not require number marking. それら is preferred when the writer wants to explicitly indicate plurality, especially in academic, legal, or official writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- それら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: those (as a modifier)
- それら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + verb: those (as an object)
- それら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: those (as a topic/subject)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦これら→これら：02814_korera⟧: these — the plural of ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧ (near the speaker)
- ⟦あれら→あれら：23758_arera⟧: those over there — the plural of ⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧ (distant)
- ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧: each one, respectively — related but means "each" rather than "those"
